Quick estimates — rough, intended for procurement/triage:

Hosted trial (short, self-serve sandbox):
- Initial token budget: 5M tokens/day (burstable)
- Sustained rate limit: ~20 requests/sec (avg 2–4k tokens/req depending on prompts)
- Typical single-node throughput: 30–60 reqs/sec depending on model and sequence length

Dedicated 1-week demo (reserved pool):
- Recommended starting config: 4x A10/A100-equivalent GPUs (model-dependent)
- Usable token budget (visible to customer): 40M tokens/day; sustained throughput 150–200 reqs/sec
- Rate-limit recommendation: 60 rps per route with ability to scale to 120 rps for load window

Notes: these are ballpark. For the short load test we can push bursts to validate KV cache and prefix caching efficiency — that will inform the final token budget.

I'll attach a csv with a couple of traffic shapes in the next mail (rate-limit-proposal.csv).

— Priyom
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
